say:1:1322537001:0.text: A spot with bigger fish? Oh, of course, it's always the spot's fault when you can't catch anything, right? Heh, typical.
say:1:1322537001:0.source_cn: 鱼又大又多的钓点？哦……我总能遇上你们这样的，鱼不多不...

say:2:1322537002:0.text: But seriously, the quieter spots usually have the bigger fish. I've heard the Floral Ruins is a nice spot. The fish there are huge!
say:2:1322537002:0.source_cn: 不过人越少去的地方鱼越大嘛，我听说遗迹花海那边倒是不错...

say:3:1322537003:0.text: It's a bit of a trek, though, so stay safe on the way there.
say:3:1322537003:0.source_cn: 不过路途遥远，你们要过去的话路上可要注意安全啊。
